🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No whole genome sequencing data access without Genomics England Data Access Committee approval and NHS ethics clearance
  • ❌ No AI medical device deployment without MHRA UKCA marking and clinical validation evidence
  • ❌ No genomic data sharing across borders without DHSC data sovereignty assessment and adequacy agreement
  • ❌ No clinical trial AI recruitment without HRA ethics approval and MHRA regulatory notification
  • ❌ No mental health AI deployment without NHS England clinical safety officer sign-off and DCB0129 compliance
  • ❌ No direct-to-consumer genomic service without MHRA registration and GMC genetic testing guidance compliance
